<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 16 % M+1) suggests about 14–15 carbons. The formula C₁₄H₁₈O₃ matches the exact mass (calculated neutral mass = 234.1256 Da, within a few mDa of the observed value) and reproduces the observed M+1 intensity. No other heteroatoms are required. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₄H₁₈O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
